messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: symmetry-forced configuration from finite reflection or rotation groups

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The symmetry-forced optimum is achieved by placing 12 points at the vertices of the regular 12-gon inscribed in the unit square's incircle (center (1/2,1/2), radius 1/2), plus the center point, yielding a minimum triangle area of (2 - √3)/16 ≈ 0.016547. The minimum area is realized by triangles formed by three consecutive 12-gon vertices. No configuration of 13 points derived from a finite dihedral or cyclic reflection/rotation group acting on the square can exceed this minimum area."}
